def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bcol=None; idx=None; orient=None
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg: bcol=g[i][0]; idx=i; orient='h'; break
    if bcol is None:
        for j in range(W):
            if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and g[0][j]!=bg: bcol=g[0][j]; idx=j; orient='v'; break
    others=[c for c in set(x for r in g for x in r) if c!=bg and c!=bcol]
    oc=others[0]
    ocells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==oc]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def fill(pos):
        if orient=='h':
            for c in range(W): out[pos][c]=8
        else:
            for r in range(H): out[r][pos]=8
    if orient=='h':
        top=min(r for r,_ in ocells); bot=max(r for r,_ in ocells)
        if idx > bot:   # border below: slide down until flush, fill above final pos
            s = (idx-1) - bot
            for r,c in ocells: out[r+s][c]=oc
            fill(top - s - 1)
        elif idx < top:
            s = (idx+1) - top
            for r,c in ocells: out[r-s][c]=oc
            fill(bot + s + 1)
        else:           # flush: no move, fill beyond object on side away from border
            fill(top+1) if idx<=bot else fill(bot-1)
    else:
        left=min(c for _,c in ocells); right=max(c for _,c in ocells)
        if idx > right:   # border right: slide right, fill left of final
            s = (idx-1) - right
            for r,c in ocells: out[r][c+s]=oc
            fill(left - s - 1)
        elif idx < left:
            s = (idx+1) - left
            for r,c in ocells: out[r][c-s]=oc
            fill(right + s + 1)
        else:
            fill(right+1) if idx<=right else fill(left-1)
    return out

    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G
G=load()

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bcol=None; idx=None; orient=None
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg: bcol=g[i][0]; idx=i; orient='h'; break
    if bcol is None:
        for j in range(W):

    others=[c for c in set(x for r in g for x in r) if c!=bg and c!=bcol]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bcol=None; idx=None; orient=None
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg: bcol=g[i][0]; idx=i; orient='h'; break
    if bcol is None:
        for j in range(W):
            col={g[i][j] for i in range(H)}
            if len(col)==1 and next(iter(col))!=bg: bcol=next(iter(col)); idx=j; orient='v'; break
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg and c!=bcol]
    oc=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==oc]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if orient=='h':
        for c in range(W): out[idx][c]=bcol
    else:
        for r in range(H): out[r][idx]=bcol
    def place(pos):
        if orient=='h':
            for c in range(W): out[pos][c]=8
        else:
            for r in range(H): out[r][pos]=8
    if orient=='h':
        lo,hi=min(r for r,_ in cells),max(r for r,_ in cells)
        if hi < idx-1:   # above border: slide DOWN so hi=idx-1
            s=(idx-1)-hi
            for r,c in cells: out[r+s][c]=oc
            place(hi+s+1)
        elif lo > idx+1: # below border: slide UP so lo=idx+1
            s=(idx+1)-lo
            for r,c in cells: out[r-s][c]=oc
            place(lo-s-1)
        else:             # already adjacent/touching
            pass
        place(hi+1 if hi>=idx else lo-1)
    else:
        lo,hi=min(c for _,c in cells),max(c for _,c in cells)
        if hi < idx-1:   # left of border: slide RIGHT so hi=idx-1
            s=(idx-1)-hi
            for r,c in cells: out[r][c+s]=oc
            place(hi+s+1)
        elif lo > idx+1: # right of border: slide LEFT so lo=idx+1
            s=(idx+1)-lo
            for r,c in cells: out[r][c-s]=oc
            place(lo-s-1)
        else:
            pass
        place(hi+1 if hi>=idx else lo-1)
    return out

allok=True
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    try:
        m = solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']; allok &= m
        print(k, m)
    except Exception as e: print(k,'ERR',e)
print('ALL', allok)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def solve(g):

    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bcol=None; idx=None; orient=None

            if len(col)==1 and next(iter(col))!=bg: bcol=next(iter(col)); idx=j; orient='v'; break
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg and c!=bcol]

    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==oc]

        if hi < idx-1:   # above border: slide DOWN so hi=idx-1
            s=(idx-1)-hi
            for r,c in cells: out[r+s][c]=oc

        elif lo > idx+1: # below border: slide UP so lo=idx+1

            s=(idx+1)-lo
            for r,c in cells: out[r][c-s]=oc
            place(lo-s-1)
        else:
            pass
        place(hi+1 if hi>=idx else lo-1)
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bcol=None; idx=None; orient=None
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg: bcol=g[i][0]; idx=i; orient='h'; break
    if bcol is None:
        for j in range(W):
            if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and g[0][j]!=bg: bcol=g[0][j]; idx=j; orient='v'; break
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg and c!=bcol]
    oc=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==oc]
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
    def place(pos):
        if orient=='h':
            for c in range(W): out[pos][c]=8
        else:
            for r in range(H): out[r][pos]=8
    if orient=='h':
        lo,hi=min(r for r,_ in cells),max(r for r,_ in cells)
        if hi < idx-1:   # above: slide DOWN until hi=idx-1 (flush)
            s=(idx-1)-hi
            for r,c in cells: out[r+s][c]=oc
            place(hi+s+1)      # fill beyond far edge (away from border)
        elif lo > idx+1: # below: slide UP until lo=idx+1
            s=(idx+1)-lo
            for r,c in cells: out[r-s][c]=oc
            place(lo-s-1)
        else:             # already flush: fill beyond far edge
            place(hi+1)
    else:
        lo,hi=min(c for _,c in cells),max(c for _,c in cells)
        if hi < idx-1:   # left: slide RIGHT until hi=idx-1
            s=(idx-1)-hi
            for r,c in cells: out[r][c+s]=oc
            place(hi+s+1)
        elif lo > idx+1: # right: slide LEFT until lo=idx+1
            s=(idx+1)-lo
            for r,c in cells: out[r][c-s]=oc
            place(lo-s-1)
        else:
            place(hi+1)
    return out

allok=True
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    try:
        m = solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']; allok &= m
        print(k, m)
    except Exception as e: print(k,'ERR',repr(e))
print('ALL', allok)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
    orient='v'; pos=None; bc=None
    for j in range(W):
        s={g[i][j] for i in range(H)}
        if len(s)==1 and list(s)[0]!=bg: bc=list(s)[0]; pos=j; break
    if bc is None:
        orient='h'
        for i in range(H):
            s={g[i][j] for j in range(W)}
            if len(s)==1 and list(s)[0]!=bg: bc=list(s)[0]; pos=i; break
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg and c!=bc]
    oc=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==oc]
    spans=(min(c for _,c in cells),max(c for _,c in cells)) if orient=='v' else (min(r for r,_ in cells),max(r for r,_ in cells))
    lo,hi=spans
    # slide object flush to border if gap small (demo2 moved with gap 3)
    if orient=='v':
        side = 'L' if hi < pos else ('R' if lo > pos else None)
        if side=='L':
            d=pos-hi
            for r,c in cells: out[r][pos-(lo-d-1)] = [out[r][c+d]][0] if False else c0 := c+d; out[r][c0]=oc
            lo,hi = pos-1-pos, hi+d   # object now occupies cols pos-(hi-d)-1 .. hi
            # simpler: object new position: cols pos-(hi-lo)... just remap
            new_lo = pos-(hi-lo)+1-? 
        elif side=='R':
            d=lo-pos-1
            for r,c in cells: out[r][c-d]=oc
            d_new=d
    def place(p, sideoff):
        if orient=='v':
            for r in range(H): out[r][p]=8
        else:
            for c in range(W): out[p][c]=8
    extent = hi-lo+1
    fill_dist = extent+1
    if orient=='v':
        side = 'L' if hi<pos else 'R'
        if side=='L': p=pos-fill_dist
        else: p=pos+fill_dist
        # slide only if gap <=3 (demo2: gap=3 moved)
        gap = min(pos-lo, hi-pos+1) if True else (pos-hi if hi<pos else lo-pos-1)
        if hi<pos and gap<=3:
            d=pos-hi
            for r,c in cells: out[r][c-d]=oc
            # redo fill based on flushed object? demo2 fill col2 = pos + (extent after slide)? object at col1, dist... use original extents
        place(fill_dist if False else p, '')
    else:
        side = 'U' if hi<pos else 'D'
        gap = pos-hi if hi<pos else lo-pos-1
        slide = gap<=3
        if slide:
            if side=='U': d=pos-hi
            else: d=lo-pos-1
            for r,c in cells: out[r-d if side=='U' else r+d if False else r][c]=oc
        d2 = extent+1
        if side=='U': p=pos-d2
        else: p=pos+d2
        place(p,side)
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    try:
        print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
    except Exception as e: print(k,'ERR',e)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Final rule check: 8-line at distance (object_extent+1) from border on object's side;
# object slides flush toward border (if gap small) so 8-line lands adjacent/available.
# Verify on all demos with full implementation, then produce test output.
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
    orient='v'; pos=None; bc=None
    for j in range(W):
        s={g[i][j] for i in range(H)}
        if len(s)==1 and list(s)[0]!=bg: bc=list(s)[0]; pos=j; break
    if bc is None:
        orient='h'
        for i in range(H):
            s={g[i][j] for j in range(W)}
            if len(s)==1 and list(s)[0]!=bg: bc=list(s)[0]; pos=i; break
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg and c!=bc]
    oc=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==oc]
    spans=(min(c for _,c in cells),max(c for _,c in cells)) if orient=='v' else (min(r for r,_ in cells),max(r for r,_ in cells))
    lo,hi=spans; extent=hi-lo+1
    def clear(cells):
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=bg
    # slide flush toward border if gap <= extent+2 (demo2 gap2 slid; demo5 gap7 didn't)
    if orient=='v':
        if hi<pos:  # left of border -> slide right
            gap=pos-lo-1
            if gap<=extent+2: d=gap
            else: d=0
            if d:
                for r,c in cells: out[r][c+d]=oc
                lo+=d; hi+=d
            p=pos+(extent+1)
        else:       # right of border -> slide left
            gap=hi-pos+1
            if gap<=extent+2: d=gap-2*0  # flush: new_hi=pos-1
            else: d=0
            if gap==hi-pos+1 and hi-pos+1>0: pass
            if gap<=extent+2:
                d=hi-(pos-1)
                for r,c in cells: out[r][c-d]=oc
                lo-=d; hi-=d
            p=pos-(extent+1)
    else:
        if hi<pos:   # above border -> slide down
            gap=pos-hi-1
            if gap<=extent+2: d=gap
            else: d=0
            if d:
                for r,c in cells: out[r+d][c]=oc
                hi+=d
            p=pos+(extent+1)
        else:        # below border -> slide up
            gap=lo-pos+1
            if gap<=extent+2: d=lo-(pos+1)
            else: d=0
            if d:
                for r,c in cells: out[r-d][c]=oc
                lo-=d
            p=pos-(extent+1)
    clear(cells)
    if orient=='v':
        for r in range(H): out[r][p]=8
    else:
        for c in range(W): out[p][c]=8
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    try: print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
    except Exception as e: print(k,'ERR',e)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # anchor: full row/col of same non-bg color (color 2 always)
    ar=next((i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==g[i][0] and g[i][0]!=bg for j in range(w))),None)
    ac=next((j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] and g[0][j]!=bg for i in range(h))),None)
    o=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,) and g[i][j]!=2]
    oc=o[0][2]
    oset={(i,j) for i,j,_ in o}
    if ar is not None:  # horizontal anchor row
        sides=set(i-ar for i,j in oset)
        assert len(sides)==1
        step=1 if min(i for i,j in oset)>ar else -1
        # slide until adjacent to anchor
        def adj(rows): return (min(rows)==ar+step) if step==1 else (max(rows)==ar-step)
        cur={i for i,j in oset}; d=1
        while not adj(cur):
            cur.add(step if step==1 else -1 if False else 0)
        # simpler: move by delta
        tgt=min(i for i in oset) if min(i for i,j in oset)>ar else max(i for i,j in oset)
        dist=(tgt-(ar+step))//step if step==1 else (tgt-(ar-step))//step
        newpos={(i+dist*step,j) for i,j in oset}
        out=[r[:] for r in g]
        for i,j in oset: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in newpos: out[i][j]=oc
        lo,hi=min(i for i,j in newpos),max(i for i,j in newpos)
        for j in range(w): out[lo+j if False else hi+1 if step==1 else lo-1 if step==-1 else 0][j]=8
        return out
    else:  # vertical anchor col
        sides=set(j-ac for i,j in oset)
        assert len(sides)==1
        step=1 if min(j for i,j in oset)>ac else -1
        tgt=min(j for i,j in oset) if min(j for i,j in oset)>ac else max(j for i,j in oset)
        dist=(tgt-(ac+step))//step
        newpos={(i,j+dist*step) for i,j in oset}
        out=[r[:] for r in g]
        for i,j in oset: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in newpos: out[i][j]=oc
        lo,hi=min(j for i,j in newpos),max(j for i,j in newpos)
        for i in range(h): out[i][hi+1 if step==1 else lo-1]=8
        return out

def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ar=next((i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==g[i][0] and g[i][0]!=bg for j in range(w))),None)
    ac=next((j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] and g[0][j]!=bg for i in range(h))),None)
    o=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,) ]
    oc=g[o[0][0]][o[0][1]]
    if ar is not None:
        rs=[i for i,_ in o]; extent=max(rs)-min(rs)+1
        smin=min(rs); smax=max(rs)
        row = smax+1 if min(rs)>ar else smin-1
        out=[r[:] for r in g]
        for j in range(w): out[row][j]=8
        return out
    else:
        cs=[j for _,j in o]; extent=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        cmin=min(cs); cmax=max(cs)
        col = cmax+1 if min(cs)>ac else cmin-1
        out=[r[:] for r in g]
        for i in range(h): out[i][col]=8
        return out
allok=True
for n in range(1,7):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    ok = solve(gi)==go; allok&=ok
    print('demo',n,ok)
print('ALL DEMOS', allok)
import json
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ar=next((i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==g[i][0] and g[i][0]!=bg for j in range(w))),None)
    ac=next((j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] and g[0][j]!=bg for i in range(h))),None)
    o=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,)]
    oc=g[o[0][0]][o[0][1]]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    if ar is not None:
        rs=[i for i,_ in o]; lo,hi=min(rs),max(rs)
        step=1 if min(rs)>ar else -1
        # slide until object flush against anchor (near edge adjacent)
        if min(rs)>ar:
            tgt=ar+1; di=tgt-hi
        else:
            tgt=ar-1; di=tgt-lo
        for i,j in o: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in o: out[i+di][j]=oc
        nlo,nhi=lo+di,hi+di
        row=nhi+1 if min(rs)>ar else nlo-1
        for j in range(w): out[row][j]=8
    else:
        cs=[j for _,j in o]; lo,hi=min(cs),max(cs)
        step=1 if min(cs)>ac else -1
        if min(cs)>ac:
            tgt=ac+1; dj=tgt-hi
        else:
            tgt=ac-1; dj=tgt-lo
        for i,j in o: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in o: out[i][j+dj]=oc
        nlo,nhi=lo+dj,hi+dj
        col=nhi+1 if min(cs)>ac else nlo-1
        for i in range(h): out[i][col]=8
    return out

allok=True
for n in range(1,7):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    ok=solve(gi)==go; allok&=ok
    print('demo',n,ok)
print('ALL DEMOS', allok)

print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

import json
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ar=next((i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==g[i][0] and g[i][0]!=bg for j in range(w))),None)
    ac=next((j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] and g[0][j]!=bg for i in range(h))),None)
    o=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,)]
    oc=g[o[0][0]][o[0][1]]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # object already flush? place 8-line adjacent beyond on far side
    if ar is not None:
        rs=[i for i,_ in o]; lo,hi=min(rs),max(rs)
        row = hi+1 if hi>ar else lo-1
        for j in range(w): out[row][j]=8
    else:
        cs=[j for _,j in o]; lo,hi=min(cs),max(cs)
        col = hi+1 if hi>ac else lo-1
        for i in range(h): out[i][col]=8
    return out
allok=True

    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]

def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ar=next((i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==g[i][0] and g[i][0]!=bg for j in range(w))),None)
    ac=next((j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] and g[0][j]!=bg for i in range(h))),None)
    o=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    oc=g[o[0][0]][o[0][1]]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # restore any strays to bg first
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=oc: out[i][j]=bg
    if ar is not None:
        rs=[i for i,_ in o]; lo,hi=min(rs),max(rs)
        step=1 if hi<ar else -1
        tgt=(ar-1)*step+1  # flush adjacent to anchor
        di=tgt-hi if step==1 else tgt-lo
        for i,j in o: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in o: out[i+di][j]=oc
        lo,hi=lo+di,hi+di
        # 8 on side away from anchor
        r8 = hi+1 if step==1 else lo-1
        for j in range(w): out[r8][j]=8
    else:
        cs=[j for _,j in o]; lo,hi=min(cs),max(cs)
        step=1 if hi<ac else -1
        tgt=(ac-1)*step+1
        dj=tgt-hi if step==1 else tgt-lo
        for i,j in o: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in o: out[i][j+dj]=oc
        lo,hi=lo+dj,hi+dj
        c8 = hi+1 if step==1 else lo-1
        for i in range(h): out[i][c8]=8
    return out
allok=True
for n in range(1,7):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    ok=solve(gi)==go; allok&=ok
    print('demo',n,ok)

def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ar=next((i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==g[i][0] and g[i][0]!=bg for j in range(w))),None)
    ac=next((j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==g[0][j] and g[0][j]!=bg for i in range(h))),None)
    o=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=2]
    oc=g[o[0][0]][o[0][1]]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # restore any stray non-bg non-object cell
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v not in (bg,2,oc): out[i][j]=bg
    if ar is not None:
        rs=[i for i,_ in o]; lo,hi=min(rs),max(rs)
        if hi>=ar-1 or lo<=ar+1:  # already touching anchor region
            pass
        else:
            step=1 if hi<ar else -1
            tgt=(ar-1)*step+1
            di=tgt-hi if step==1 else tgt-lo
            for i,j in o: out[i][j]=bg
            for i,j in o: out[i+di][j]=oc
            lo,hi=lo+di,hi+di
        r8 = hi+1 if hi<ar else lo-1
        for j in range(w): out[r8][j]=8
    else:
        cs=[j for _,j in o]; lo,hi=min(cs),max(cs)
        if hi>=ac-1 or lo<=ac+1:
            pass
        else:
            step=1 if hi<ac else -1
            tgt=(ac-1)*step+1
            dj=tgt-hi if step==1 else tgt-lo
            for i,j in o: out[i][j]=bg
            for i,j in o: out[i][j+dj]=oc
            lo,hi=lo+dj,hi+dj
        c8 = hi+1 if hi<ac else lo-1
        for i in range(h): out[i][c8]=8
    return out

import json
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ar=next((i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg),None)
    ac=next((j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and g[0][j]!=bg),None)
    o=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=2]
    oc=g[o[0][0]][o[0][1]]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    if o:
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=2 and g[i][j]!=oc: out[i][j]=bg
    if ar is not None:
        rs=[i for i,_ in o]; lo,hi=min(rs),max(rs)
        if hi>=ar-1 or lo<=ar+1:
            r8 = hi+1 if hi<ar else lo-1
            for j in range(w): out[r8][j]=8
            return out
        diag=1 if hi<ar else -1
        tgt=(ar-1)*diag+1
        d=tgt-hi if diag==1 else tgt-lo
        for i,j in o: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in o: out[i+d][j]=oc
        r8=hi+1 if diag==1 else lo-1
        for j in range(w): out[r8][j]=8
    elif ac is not None:
        cs=[j for _,j in o]; lo,hi=min(cs),max(cs)
        if hi>=ac-1 or lo<=ac+1:
            c8 = hi+1 if hi<ac else lo-1
            for i in range(h): out[i][c8]=8
            return out
        diag=1 if hi<ac else -1
        tgt=(ac-1)*diag+1
        d=tgt-hi if diag==1 else tgt-lo
        for i,j in o: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in o: out[i][j+d]=oc
        c8=hi+1 if diag==1 else lo-1
        for i in range(h): out[i][c8]=8
    return out
allok=True

    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    ok=f(gi)==go; allok&=ok

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    anc=[]
    for i in range(h):
        if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg: anc.append(('r',i,g[i][0]))
    for j in range(w):
        if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and g[0][j]!=bg: anc.append(('c',j,g[0][j]))
    t,a,v=anc[0]
    o=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=v]
    oc=g[o[0][0]][o[0][1]]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    cells=set(o)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=v and g[i][j]!=oc and (i,j) not in cells: out[i][j]=bg
    if t=='r':
        lo=min(i for i,_ in cells); hi=max(i for i,_ in cells)
        if hi<a: d=a-1-hi          # slide up to touch anchor
        else: d=a+1-lo             # slide down
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=bg; out[i+d][j]=oc
        nlo,nhi=lo+d,hi+d
        r8=nhi+1 if d>0 else nlo-1   # away from anchor
        for j in range(w): out[r8][j]=8
    else:
        lo=min(j for _,j in cells); hi=max(j for _,j in cells)
        if hi<v: d=v-1-hi
        else: d=v+1-lo
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=bg; out[i][j+d]=oc
        nlo,nhi=lo+d,hi+d
        c8=nhi+1 if d>0 else nlo-1
        for i in range(h): out[i][c8]=8
    return out
allok=True
for n in range(1,8):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    got=f(gi)
    diff=[(i,j,got[i][j],go[i][j]) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if got[i][j]!=go[i][j]]
    allok&=not diff
    print('demo',n,'ok' if not diff else 'diffs:',diff[:6])
print('ALL',allok)
